title: It serves its purpose, looks/feels cheap
text:
It serves its purpose, looks/feels cheap. The packaging was a bit much, large box for a rod that’s about an inch thick. Typical shipping for you I’ve come to expect. Item arrived undamaged which was wonderful, then I opened the item and well not gonna lie it’s super basic looking imo. A cheap looking chrome rod, def should have bought a higher price one so far it’s fell once but maybe I didn’t get it tight as it needed... but when you are snugging it up it honestly feels like I may strip the tensioner out and break it.

Wouldn’t say I’d buy it again, but for $13 what did I expect. Live and learn lol

product_metadata.title: Zenna Home NeverRust, 66 to 110-Inch Rustproof Shower Rod, Bronze
features: SHOWER ROD WILL NEVER RUST: Strong, lightweight aluminum construction makes this rod guaranteed rustproof
ADJUSTABLE AND MADE TO FIT YOUR SHOWER: Adjustable-length tension rod fits in any standard- and most oversized shower spaces (adjusts from 66 to 110 inches) with no cutting required
EASY TO INSTALL IN JUST 2 STEPS: No drilling, no tools and no damage to walls
LIFETIME GUARANTEE AGAINST RUST, AND LOOKS GREAT TOO: Bronze finish fits well with almost any bath décor; rod includes color-matched end caps
NOT JUST FOR YOUR SHOWER: Rod also can be used to hang curtains in windows, or for closet storage or as a room divider
description: The Zenna Home NeverRust Adjustable Tension Shower Rod provides an easy, rustproof way to hang a shower curtain in almost any standard or oversized bath space. Thanks to its innovative TwistTight tension-mount mechanism, this rustproof shower rod installs easily in any shower area from 66 to 110 inches long. Or you can use this rod to hang curtains, for closet storage or as a room divider. Just extend the rod to the wall, twist and tighten in place for secure installation. No tools are needed, and there's no damage to shower walls. The rod has rotating rubber end pads to eliminate wall crawling during installation. This NeverRust shower rod is for life against rust. Its nickel finish coordinates with almost any bath decor.
